classification.difficultyReason: Construct probability distributions for three draws with and without replacement, then calculate and compare their moments.

content.prompt: A set of cards contains 5 blue and 7 white cards. 3 are drawn at random. Let $X$ be the number of blue cards drawn. Find the mean and variance of $X$ if the cards are drawn as follows. Give non-exact decimal answers to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked:
The probability of blue on each draw is $\frac5{12}$ and of white is $\frac7{12}$. Replacement makes the draws independent.

$$\begin{aligned}P(X=0)&=\left(\frac7{12}\right)^3=\frac{343}{1728}\\P(X=1)&=3\left(\frac5{12}\right)\left(\frac7{12}\right)^2=\frac{735}{1728}\\P(X=2)&=3\left(\frac5{12}\right)^2\left(\frac7{12}\right)=\frac{525}{1728}\\P(X=3)&=\left(\frac5{12}\right)^3=\frac{125}{1728}\end{aligned}$$

The factor 3 counts the possible positions of the single blue card or the single white card.

$$\begin{aligned}E(X)&=\frac{0(343)+1(735)+2(525)+3(125)}{1728}\\E(X)&=\frac54=1.25\\E(X^2)&=\frac{0^2(343)+1^2(735)+2^2(525)+3^2(125)}{1728}\\E(X^2)&=\frac{55}{24}\\\operatorname{Var}(X)&=E(X^2)-[E(X)]^2\\\operatorname{Var}(X)&=\frac{55}{24}-\left(\frac54\right)^2\\\operatorname{Var}(X)&=\frac{35}{48}\approx0.73\end{aligned}$$

Without replacement, the numbers of cards available change after each draw.

$$\begin{aligned}P(X=0)&=\frac7{12}\times\frac6{11}\times\frac5{10}=\frac{35}{220}\\P(X=1)&=3\times\frac5{12}\times\frac7{11}\times\frac6{10}=\frac{105}{220}\\P(X=2)&=3\times\frac5{12}\times\frac4{11}\times\frac7{10}=\frac{70}{220}\\P(X=3)&=\frac5{12}\times\frac4{11}\times\frac3{10}=\frac{10}{220}\end{aligned}$$

For one blue card there are three possible colour orders, each with the same probability. The same applies to two blue cards.

$$\begin{aligned}E(X)&=\frac{0(35)+1(105)+2(70)+3(10)}{220}\\E(X)&=\frac54=1.25\\E(X^2)&=\frac{0^2(35)+1^2(105)+2^2(70)+3^2(10)}{220}\\E(X^2)&=\frac{95}{44}\\\operatorname{Var}(X)&=E(X^2)-[E(X)]^2\\\operatorname{Var}(X)&=\frac{95}{44}-\left(\frac54\right)^2\\\operatorname{Var}(X)&=\frac{105}{176}\approx0.60\end{aligned}$$
